description: This header file declares the KmlParser class responsible for parsing KML files to extract GPS fixes. It provides static methods to parse files and strings containing KML data, with error handling support.

classes.name: KmlParser
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for parsing KML files and strings to extract GPS fixes.

methods.name: parseFile
methods.description: Parses a KML file at the specified file path and extracts GPS fixes into the provided GpsFixArray. Returns true on success, false on failure and sets the error message.

methods.name: parseString
methods.description: Parses a KML string of given length to extract GPS fixes into the provided GpsFixArray. Returns true on success, false on failure with error message.
